name: icon-cloud

frames.best_why: Many brand logos are lit across the sphere with clear depth, from bright front icons to faint rear ones.

tagline: Tech logos float on an invisible globe that slowly turns.
summary: A canvas showing dozens of small brand icons arranged on a sphere, with front logos bright and rear ones faded, rotating on its own and spinning when dragged.
appearance: A loose circular cluster of small, colourful developer logos on black, with no visible sphere outline. Logos near the middle-front are sharp and bright, while those toward the edges fade almost to black.
behaviour: The whole cluster turns slowly as if on a globe, logging drifting in and out of focus. Dragging spins it with the pointer, and clicking a logo eases the globe round to face it.
demo_content: Brand logos including TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Vercel, Docker, GitHub and Figma.
search_phrases: brand icons spinning in a sphere
use_when: A product wants to show a large set of tech or brand logos as a rotating globe.
avoid_when: Phones or keyboard-only users; the canvas has no touch or keyboard controls.
customise: Pass an images array of URLs, or icons nodes; the 400px canvas size, sphere layout and drag physics are fixed in the source.
weight_why: A canvas redraws every icon on every frame in a requestAnimationFrame loop.

a11y.note: The canvas is labelled as a 3D icon cloud but has no keyboard or touch controls, and the auto-spin ignores reduced-motion.

issues: The canvas is fixed at 400x400 with no touch handlers, so it does not work on phones.
Rear logos fade almost to black and become hard to identify.
polish_why: Smooth depth shading and a convincing sphere; several back logos are too faint to read.
title: Icon Cloud
